summary: Implemented App.call_from_thread in src/textual/app.py, with thread-entry state initialized in __init__ and set/cleared in run_async (body moved into _run_async_main so cleanup runs on every exit path). Added tests/test_call_from_thread.py: 10 tests, all passing on the venv when run with PYTHONPATH pointing at the repo's src (the venv's editable textual install points at a sibling base/ checkout). Excluded tests/devtools and tests/cli because aiohttp is missing from the venv. Remaining 68 failures in the wider suite are async tests the venv cannot run (no async pytest plugin); not verified against base. Nothing committed.
